column1: # Top developer terms by real demand — the coverage yardstick.
# Why this file exists: the dictionary was growing by *novelty* (whatever
# trended this week) and had never been checked against *demand*. On
# 2026-11-12 it held 1,936 entries and still had no row for python, git,
# java, jquery, xcode, or node.js — while /api/word/python.json returned 404.
# Coverage is measured against this snapshot so the gap can only shrink.
# 2026-11-12. `count` = questions on that tag: a demand proxy, nothing else.
#   kind = in-scope  a product / tool / language / API name a developer asks
#                     how to SAY — these are supposed to resolve
#          english   generic vocabulary (algorithm, arrays, string); the
#                     dictionary's stated scope excludes it, and raw TTS
